title_en: From below comes the bald pasha
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional mocking song about an Ottoman pasha. 'Нане' as a refrain addressing the mother is my reading.

lines.en: From below comes the bald pasha,
mother, dear mother, the bald pasha.

lines.cyr: На ќелава глава црно фесче носи,
lines.lat: Na ḱelava glava crno fesče nosi,
lines.en: On his bald head he wears a black fez,

lines.cyr: нане, мило нане, црно фесче носи.
lines.lat: nane, milo nane, crno fesče nosi.
lines.en: mother, dear mother, he wears a black fez.

lines.cyr: На грбави плешчи тенка пушка носи,
lines.lat: Na grbavi plešči tenka puška nosi,
lines.en: On his hunched back he carries a thin rifle,

lines.cyr: нане, мило нане, тенка пушка носи.
lines.lat: nane, milo nane, tenka puška nosi.
lines.en: mother, dear mother, he carries a thin rifle.

lines.cyr: А на криви нозе, чизми до колена,
lines.lat: A na krivi noze, čizmi do kolena,
lines.en: And on crooked legs, boots to the knees,

lines.cyr: нане, мило нане, чизми до колена.
lines.lat: nane, milo nane, čizmi do kolena.
lines.en: mother, dear mother, boots to the knees.
